programme.title: Colours of Nature
programme.desc: From subtle to shocking, colour enhances the beauty of the natural world. Colour is a language to most living things, whether as a warning, camouflage or a come on. But there's more to colour than just pigment. Colours define how many animals behave, how they mate and how they inter-act with one another. For us the beautiful and varied shades of the animal kingdom form a spec-tacular kaleidoscope of colours. With all the diversity in the world, sit back and enjoy all the col-ours of the animal kingdom.

programme.title: Nature's Most Dangerous
programme.desc: Who's not a thrill seeker among us? We humans love to put ourselves at risk and lap up the thrill of living dangerously. And to fuel our fetish for fear, we turn to the animal kingdom. But what is the truth behind the killers of the natural world? Do they live up to their reputations, and who really is the most dangerous? From killer crocs to ferocious big cats, we'll run you through the most dangerous teeth, fangs, stingers and bites in the animal kingdom. These are the deadliest animals on planet earth.

programme.title: Hidden Australia
programme.desc: Sometimes called the biggest island on Earth, Australia is a sub-continent of incredible diversity, beauty, danger and downright weirdness. The 4,000km between the coasts are made up of a patchwork of contrasting landscapes: tropical rainforests, snow-capped mountains, dry woodland, giant wetlands, tropical reefs and hostile desert. These vast tracts of wilderness boast the world's most unique and bizarre wildlife communities. In this ‘hidden' Australia, there is an astonishing surprise at every turn.

programme.title: Montenegro
programme.sub-title: From the Black Mountains to the Beach
programme.desc: The Balkan land of Montenegro owes its name to the Black Mountains. But there is so much more: steep cliffs, deep gorges, picturesque lakes, orthodox monasteries, Venetian architecture, sandy beaches and even fjords like those of Norway. There are three climate zones alone in the Adriatic. The inhabitants still try to find their way between the challenges of a post-socialist system, the much-vaunted Balkan remoteness and the opportunities of a still almost completely undiscovered tourist destination in Europe.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: Rugged coasts, untouched nature and the rough climate of the Atlantic characterize the landscape on the west coast of Scotland. In the sounds and lochs of the Scottish West, "Waverley", the last seaworthy passenger steamship in the world, appears once a year. The side-wheel steamer was built in 1947 to carry out short ferry passages on the Clyde River. Today, "Waverley" circumnavigates almost all of Great Britain. The impressive ship was sold to the "Paddle Steamer Preservation Society" in 1974 for the symbolic price of one English pound. Since then, she starts her season off the Western Isles in Scotland every year in May.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: Lake Lucerne in the heart of Switzerland stretches from the foothills of the Alps to the first three-thousand-meter peaks of the high mountains. Home waters of the paddle steamer Unterwalden. For two and a half years she was not on the water. Now, after the biggest renovation in her history, the life of the 110-year-old paddle steamer is starting all over again. Her first voyages, with all the imponderables and challenges for the crew, take her into a diverse, wild landscape, right into the mystical heart of Switzerland. In their territory, scenic contrasts collide: barren high moorland and gently rolling alpine meadows, modern tourist resorts and quiet mountain villages, caves hidden deep in the earth and snow-covered two-thousand-meter peaks. The Unterwalden is part of the oldest and largest fleet of paddle steamers so high above the sea. Here on Lake Lucerne, according to national legend, the three original cantons swore eternal allegiance to each other over seven hundred years ago. A land around which countless myths entwine and whose lifeline since the opening of the Gotthard Pass in the thirteenth century was the shipping traffic on the lake.

programme.title: Fertile Floods
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: Getting Out the Vote
programme.desc: It's Stephanie vs. Tanya for Heartlake High Class President. But when Tanya resorts to dirty tricks, Stephanie decides to give her a taste of her own medicine. Elect Tanya as Heartlake High Class President?! "NOOOOOOOO!!!!" Not if Friends Stephanie, Emma, Olivia, Mia and Andrea can help it. The Friends are there to help their pal Matthew defeat Tanya -- even when Emma gets carried off by "Vote For Matthew" balloons! But Tanya figures since "Daddy" is now the Mayor of Heartlake City, she doesn't have to play by the rules. When she sneakily sabotages Matthew's campaign, it's time for a determined Stephanie to take his place as candidate. With the help of her friends, Stephanie is set on running a clean campaign -- that is, until Tanya resorts to more dirty tricks, and Stephanie decides to give Tanya a taste of her own medicine.

programme.title: Getting Tthe Message
programme.desc: they need to brave space rides, dunking booths, an angry innocent text to Mia was sent to Matthew by mistake -- a brute and worse - the boys locker room!BFF's, the Friends must scramble to retrieve Matthew's undying love for Matthew! But first, As the Friends enjoy Heartlake Amusement Park, Emma types a text to Mia, but sends it to Matthew by mistake a text that could be mega-embarrassing for Emma! As her BFF's, the Friends race to find Matthew's phone and erase the text before he reads it. But first, they must brave space rides, dunking booths and worse: the boys locker room! What's more frightening than a roller coaster? More frantic race against time when Emma discovers that her Friends' fun day at Heartlake Amusement Park turns into a text that accidentally sounds like a pledge of Emma's

programme.title: The Grateful Dud
programme.desc: At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a teen bulldozer named Fiona. But when Fiona's pushy, over-the-top appreciation makes Mia's life a living nightmare, the Friends must Ride To The Rescue! At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a brassy teen bulldozer named Fiona. Although Fiona means well, her pushy, over-the-top appreciation soon makes Mia's life a living nightmare: embarrassing Mia at school, scaring away her boyfriend, and causing major havoc at the Country Club. The Friends must find a way for Mia to escape Fiona's nonstop gratitude and foil Tanya's sneaky schemes to get Mia kicked out of the club. And when a crisis erupts at the club's Fall Ball and Horse Show, all the Friends have to do some fancy riding to help their BFF save the day.

programme.title: Black Out
programme.desc: The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd. After destroying the Power Station, the Ninja have dealt a massive blow to the Nindroids, but find getting back to the city troublesome without power. At the Junk Yard, Zane gives half of his heart to revive Pixal to help give guidance in their greater mission. Meanwhile, a mysterious cloaked Interloper steals the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord and creates a new foe for the Ninja to fight… Tech Wu. On the other side of Ninjago, Lloyd is trained by his father to harness his Golden Power to unlock an even greater potential – the power of the First Spinjtzu Master.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Golden Master
programme.desc: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas' search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd. The Ninja return to a powerless New Ninjago City and visit the Serpentine Tombs in effort to solve who had taken the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord – only to discover the snakes have gone straight. They learn of Serpentine Lore that a Golden Master will conquer all of Ninjago. The Nindroids attack, but with the help from Scales and his Serpentine ilk, they fight off the enemy and discover the culprit they are after is none other than Pythor! But it's too late… the Digital Overlord and his henchman have captured Lloyd in a plot to sap his Golden Power to finally become flesh.

programme.title: Enter The Digiverse
programme.desc: Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive. Unable to save Lloyd in time, the Ninja resort to drastic measures. With the help from Borg's advanced technology, the Ninja get digitized with their Techno Blades into the Digiverse in order to battle the Digital Overlord on his own turf and erase evil for good. While the Ninja learn new capabilities and explore the fantasy of a ‘digital world', their friends must protect them from Pythor and his army in the ‘real world'. In the climatic conclusion, the Ninja ‘reboot the system' and save Sensei Wu and Lloyd, but the Digital Overlord has managed to become flesh in the nick of time, only to be in a weakened state.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend. The loss of Zane has fractured the team of Ninja, but when a mysterious invitation to Master Chen's ‘Tournament of Elements' arrives, everything is thrown into question – Is Zane alive, and are there others out there with powers like them? Sensei Garmadon warns them not to trust Master Chen, but they go in order to find Zane and make the team whole. On route to the island, the Ninja are briefly introduced to the other unique fighters with elemental powers, and the mysterious and beautiful Skylor intrigues Kai. Kai gets into a humbling scrap with Karlof, the Master of Metal, and learns some fights must be done on your own.

programme.title: The King's Tournament
programme.desc: Rival to the King, Jorah Tightwad thinks his knights – the Tighty Knighties – are easily better than the NEXO-Knights, so he challenges King Halbert to prove who's better during the King's Birthday Tournament. It's the King's birthday! To celebrate, the Queen and Macy always throw him a great, big birthday party consisting of a feast on birthday eve and a tournament the next day. At the birthday banquet is JORAH TIGHTWAD (last seen in episode 104.) He's goading the King (and on his birthday, even) and going on and on about how his knights are better than the NEXO-Knights. The King protests, but Jorah asks “How many magical books have your knights recovered? None, zilch, zero.” But he produces the BOOK OF ENVY, which his superior knights captured from Jestro. The next day, the NEXO-Knights square off against Tightwad's four knights: JOUSTING BEEBER, BRICKNEY SPEARS, SHIA LABLADE and THE BLOK. We see that all these knights are envious of the NEXO-Knights: their weapons, their fame, their hair, etc. Macy is also disappointed to find out she CAN'T fight in the tournament – she's agreed to be in “princess mode” for her father's birthday. During the tournament, we see that Tightwad's knights are amazing in fighting contests. They all pair-off with knights who have their same weapons skills. Tightwad makes fun of the NEXO-Knights as his knights do well. Jestro and the Book of Monsters discover that Tightwad has the Book of Envy and he and his monsters attack the tournament. Then we learn that Tightwad's knights might be good tournament fighters, but they can't handle real fights and the NEXO-Knights must save them! Macy is finally able to join in the fight when she sees Magmar show up on the flank. The NEXO-Knights successfully defend the king, but Jestro gets away with the Book of Envy. Tightwad must admit his knights never won the book from Jestro he got the book when Merlok blasted books of magic across the realm. Tightwad's knights all admit that they really admire the NEXO-Knights.

programme.title: Monster Chef
programme.desc: Axl and Chef Éclair must enter a cooking contest to try to keep Jestro from getting the hottest chili recipe in the realm. Knighton celebrity chef GOBBLETON RAMBLEY announces that he's developed the hottest chili recipe ever created. Now, he intends to give the recipe to the winner of his “Hottest Chili Cook-Off Competition” cooking show on Knighton TV. He'll turn over his famous Chili Cookbook with the hottest chili recipe on the last page. It's so unique it can't be recreated without it. Jestro and the Book of Monsters think they MUST have that recipe. “Hot chili makes hot monsters!” Merlok knows that this recipe, in the wrong hands – meaning Jestro's – could be dangerous. But when the Knights appeal to the egomaniacal chef, he says the only way to get the recipe is to win it from him. So Axl and Chef Éclair decide to enter. The team that creates the hottest chili will win Rambley's cookbook. Chef Éclair is unsure that Axl has the skills to help them win the competition, but, as we see through funny cooking show bits, Axl is quite good and they become a pretty good team. (We will also learn that years ago, Rambley stole one of Éclair's best recipes and they don't like each other.) While watching the multi-part competition, Aaron and Lance have a contest of their own: who can eat the hottest chili. Axl and Éclair actually win the competition, coming up with a raging hot chili recipe. Before they can claim their prize, Jestro and his monsters attack with Magmar leading the way on his siege tower. They must get that cookbook! During the battle, Rambley's cookbook is accidentally melted. After the battle, Rambley announces his new quest: to make the sweetest ice cream ever! While Axl and Éclair cook happily in the kitchen of the Fortrex, back in the Redoubt of Ruination, Jestro and Lavaria are attempting to recreate Rambley's chili recipe. They keep spooning various recipes of chili into the Book of Monsters. “Nope, not hot enough…waaaay too much garlic….you call that hot?!” (BELCH!)

programme.title: Knight Out
programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.desc: The Female Bear presents Masha with a glamour magazine and now the Bear shall transform his house into a beauty salon. Get ready to learn a lesson that everything should be done with a sense of proportion, especially when it comes to beauty.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The best remedy for boredom is a good game. And a good play is even better. That is exactly what our friends decided. It's just not so easy to agree on what kind of play to stage..

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one's pains”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This is a story about the small but brave boy. The moral of the story is that no matter how big and tall you are, you should not offend the little ones. It may happen so that you will meet some tom thumb boy, who will beat any “giant”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a woman who had three daughters - two of her own and the stepdaughter called Wee Little Havroshechka. She loved her own daughters and hated the stepdaughter who was forced to work till dawn. No matter how hard she tried to please the stepmother, she was unapproachable. Once upon a time the stepmother kicked her out of the house, but every medal has its flipside – Wee Little Havroshechka met her Prince and they lived happily ever after, and it's all because she was hard-working and clean.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. And he will tell about Bear's childhood and how he was mischievous with the Himalayan bear. Has anything changed since then? We will learn it from the new episode. And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

And in the company of an old friend, this research becomes an adventure. "

The Bear decides to restore it and invites the female Bear for a romantic ride! No one would have expected that this story would perfectly match Masha's new hobby - puppet theatre.

But what will he catch if all his floats are gone for crafts? Is it Masha, to put her in a corner? Well, not this time. Friendship always wins in our creative contests!

The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: Sinister Saga Of A Sick Tummy And A Girl Who Was Afraid Of Doctors
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. She took some clay and made “meat balls” with “semolina porridge”. As the meal seemed tasty, Sima decided to eat a bit of her dinner too… And so she lies in her bad and feels a horrible stomachache. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales

Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: AGNI VAYU
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: My Secret,Terrius Ep.12 (English Dub)
programme.desc: Koh Ae-rin, a mom that quit her job a long time ago, starts looking for a job to make a living when her husband suddenly passes away. While doing something no one asked her to at her new job, she finds out a secret of the Korean office of Cornerstone, an international military industrial complex. She gets involved with Kim Bon, the man next door that has been chasing after a huge conspiracy and involuntarily becomes a member of Kingsbag, a special organization within the National Intelligence Service(NIS). She grows rapidly within the world of intelligence, which had seemed like a totally different world to her, and shows great performance that even surprises the NIS agents.

programme.title: UMEED INDIA
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: BHARAT RATNA THE JEWELS OF INDIA
programme.desc: Bharat Ratna The Jewels of India is a show that celebrates the recipients of India's highest civilian honour. Through the medium of graphics and information, the show, intends to exhibit hidden unknown and loved stories from lives of these legendary characters.

programme.title: EPIC KE DUS
programme.desc: Epic Ke Dus is a halfhour collated list of the top ten people, places or events of a chosen topic, examples of which include rivalries, thinkers and warriors. Each topic has been thoroughly researched and a panel of experts on the subject has carefully selected the stories that are fitting to be part of the topic. This panel is seen on the episodes giving their views on the events, the significance of the event and describing the mood of the era, publics reaction to these events and how it contributed to change the course of Indian history.

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, host Micah Trainor takes a stab at Cassoulet with buttery white beans, duck leg confit, and flavourful French sausage - and the result is mouth-wateringly good! The pressure's on, but Tiera Singh doesn't let up with her Chinese Long Bean Stir Fry. Succulent sausage, delicious duck breast, and flavorful vegetables come together for a truly sumptuous dish! For her vegetarian variant, Missy Hui must move things up a notch, but how? Agedashi Tofu! Breaded crispy semi-firm tofu is doused in a dashi, gochujang, and mirin mixture for the ultimate umami mouthful. Poppy Sandler goes above and beyond with her Chocolate-crusted Elk Loin, seared and drizzled with a decadent Coffee- Blueberry Demi-Glace - sound strange? Tastes terrific!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Who said dessert couldn't come before dinner? In this episode of Up the Dish, host Missy Hui serves up a hedonistically hard-to-beat Carrot Cake, made extra-moist with applesauce and tons of cream cheese icing. Micah Trainor ditches dessert and heads for the healthy option - a Cider Poached Chicken Waldorf Salad full of pecans and cinnamon for that classic cake flavour. Poppy Sandler innovates with Indian inspiration - carrot cake becomes Carrot Rostis, thin pancakes dished out with perfectly poached eggs and a homemade savoury raisin jam. Tiera Singh returns to the Rock and makes Jerk Crab Salad Mango Rolls. Jazzing up the crab meat with a blend of Jamaican jerk and autumn spices, she finishes the dish by wrapping the mixture in layers of smooth avocado slices and juicy mango.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: First up on this episode of Up the Dish is Poppy Sandler's Borscht straight from the Eastern Bloc! A mix of roasted and simmered beets adds complexity to the creamy soup - and don't forget that vivid burgundy hue. Tiera Singh swaps soup for a sandwich with her Beet-Stained Trout Gravlax, pairing the eye-catching seafood with zesty lemon-dill cream cheese and rye pumpernickel bread. Next, Micah Trainor mixes up a vegetarian Roasted Beet Salad paired with crackly Seed Brittle and a simple sweet dressing it's a crunchy, earthy delight! Missy Hui's three-layer Red Beet Velvet Cake is a true triple threat. Red beet puree gives this cake its vermillion colour - and pairing it with tangy goat cheese icing... well, it just makes sense!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Micah Trainor boils it down for this episode of Up the Dish! Her Cajun Seafood Boil simmers with luscious lobster, smoky andouille, and supERS-sized crab a perfect blend of zesty, spicy, and succulent. It's a hard act to follow, but Missy Hui is up for it. Her Corned Beef Boiled Dinner is a call back to the Emerald Isle - home-cured pickled beef bubbles away with veggies in a beefy broth. Poppy Sandler's vegetarian addition? Moroccan Vegetable Stew! A North African-style spice blend heats this dish up, while chickpeas and other veggies soak up the flavour. Tiera Singh takes a spicy approach with her one-pot delight - Guyanese Pepperpot. programme.title: Le Motorizzate

Si susseguono: una suora dalla guida spericolata una mondana che vive su una roulotte uno sportivo che rifiuta il passaggio offertogli da una bella motorizzata un falso vigile che intasca svariate multe e uno squattrinato che si lascia investire sperando di ricavare un grosso guadagno.

programme.title: Basta con la guerra… facciamo l'amore
programme.desc: Lo zio di un seminarista decide che il nipote dev'essere spinto a esplorare l'interesse verso le donne e, per aiutarlo, si fa assistere dalla moglie e dalla cameriera.

programme.title: Gli amici di Nick Hezard
programme.desc: Per vendicare la morte del suo amico, un giovane lestofante in Svizzera predispone un'ingegnosa truffa ai danni del principale responsabile, un affarista americano. Gli fa credere di esser stato coinvolto in un omicidio e fa in modo di sottrargli una grossa quantità di denaro. L'attuazione del piano, però, non sarà affatto semplice.

programme.title: Il brigadiere Pasquale Zagaria ama la mamma e la polizia
programme.desc: Primo film da protagonista di Lino Banfi. Degradato e infine espulso dalla polizia per inettitudine comprovata, il brigadiere pugliese Pasquale Zagaria si ritira a vita privata nella campagna romana. Ma ben presto resta coinvolto in un oscuro traffico di diamanti. Con l'aiuto della vigorosa moglie Pupetta, cintura nera di karate, Zagaria torna ad affrontare i delinquenti.

programme.title: Hot Corn Cine News
programme.desc: Live dall' 83ª Mostra del cinema di Venezia! Uno sguardo ravvicinato ad alcuni dei migliori film italiani passati dal festival: L'estranea di Paolo Strippoli Il fuoco che ti porti dentro, con un'intervista a Edoardo De Angelis La città dei vivi, con un'intervista al protagonista, Emanuele Maria Di Stefano Scherzetto, con interviste a Mario Martone, Serena Rossi e Toni Servillo Nessun dolore, con interviste a Gianni Amelio e Alessandro Borghi.

programme.title: Telefoni Bianchi
programme.desc: Nel vivace affresco diretto da Dino Risi, una giovane impiegata sogna di diventare attrice e entrare nel brillante ma ipocrita mondo del cinema dei "telefoni bianchi". Tra ambizioni, compromessi e seduzioni, scopre quanto sia fragile il confine tra successo e illusione. Risi offre una satira acuta sull'ascesa sociale e sul fascino ingannevole dello spettacolo.

programme.title: Peccato che sia una canaglia
programme.desc: La vita di Paolo (Marcello Mastroianni), un tranquillo e indolente autista di taxi, viene sconvolta dall'incontro con Lina (Sophia Loren), una bella ragazza, abile in borseggi e piccole truffe. Lina e la sua famiglia, sconclusionata come lei, affascinano Paolo che ce la mette tutta per redimere la ragazza. Con Vittorio De Sica nei panni del Prof. Stroppiani, padre di Lina.

programme.title: La fortuna di essere donna
programme.desc: Antonietta (Sophia Loren), una giovane di famiglia modesta, diventa per caso una ragazza copertina. Corrado, il fotografo che l'ha scoperta, si innamora e lei lo fa ingelosire frequentando il conte Senetti, il quale le insegna le buone maniere. Il nobile le regala una pelliccia e le promette di sposarla, ma presto si farà viva una persona che porterà scompiglio.

programme.title: Ciao maschio
programme.desc: Il rifiuto della paternità e la scelta di adottare come figlio una scimmietta saranno per il protagonista, Lafayette , l'ultima e delirante affermazione di individualità.

programme.title: L'ingorgo
programme.desc: Un corteo di macchine procede sempre più lentamente lungo la tangenziale di Roma, sino a che ogni possibilità di movimento si blocca. L`ingorgo durerà 36 ore. Sin dai primi momenti il nervosismo dei viaggiatori è evidente. Quando sfumano le speranze di una veloce soluzione, mancano notizie, si palesano le prime necessità, la tensione sale al massimo e non pochi trascendono. La circostanza permette di scoprire i lati peggiori dell`umanità presente...

programme.title: Piccolo mondo antico
programme.desc: Durante il Risorgimento, un giovane di nobile casato sposa, contro il volere della nonna austricante, una donna borghese e va a vivere sul lago di Como. La loro bambina annega per una svista fatale, e la giovane madre quasi impazzisce. Si riprende solo quando lo sposo, che intanto ha aderito ai movimenti clandestini rivoluzionari, annuncia la sua partenza per la guerra di Crimea.

programme.title: Aida
programme.desc: Il giovane Radames, condottiero delle truppe egiziane e trionfatore sugli Etiopi nella guerra per il possesso dell`alta valle del Nilo, ottiene dal faraone la liberazione della bellissima schiava Aida, di cui è innamorato, e di suo padre, Amonasro, re degli etiopi. Costretta dall`autorità del padre, Aida induce Radames a rivelare il segreto delle future mosse dell`esercito egiziano.

programme.title: Spore
programme.desc: Due amiche disegnatrici di fumetti, uno stupro, un omicidio per vendetta, una fuga. Sullo sfondo gli anni Ottanta, quelli delle fanzine e del punk, del referendum contro il nucleare e di una provincia sempre troppo stretta.

programme.title: A Kid Like Jake
programme.desc: Alex Wheeler e suo marito Greg stanno cercando di trovare la scuola elementare giusta per il loro figlio di 4 anni, Jake. Descritto come gender-expansive dal suo consulente, il comportamento sempre più irregolare di Jake inizia a causare una spaccatura tra la coppia. Alex teme che gli adulti della sua vita lo stiano etichettando prematuramente, mentre Greg si chiede se la passione di Jake per i travestimenti non sia solo una fase.

programme.title: Sweetness in the Belly
programme.desc: Lilly, una giovane rimasta orfana da bambina mentre era in Africa, arriva nel Regno Unito, patria dei genitori, da rifugiata per fuggire dalla guerra civile. Lilly diventerà una presenza importante nella comunità degli immigrati che vivono a Londra e cercherà di riunire famiglie divise dai conflitti. La sua amica Amina scopre, però, che Lilly ha una storia d'amore con Aziz, un medico idealista.

programme.title: Bergman 100: La Vita, I Segreti, Il Genio
programme.desc: Il documentario ricostruisce un anno fondamentale nella vita di Ingmar Bergman, il maestro del cinema, focalizzandosi sugli eventi che segnarono la sua carriera, tra l'uscita di Il posto delle fragole e Il settimo sigillo. Un viaggio nella sua arte, i suoi segreti e il suo genio creativo.

programme.title: TUTTO PER UN FIGLIO
programme.desc: Dopo la scomparsa improvvisa del figlio appena nato, una madre cerca disperatamente la verità mentre emergono segreti sconvolgenti.

programme.title: UN ANNO PER CAMBIARE
programme.desc: Dopo esser caduto da un tetto alla festa di Capodanno ed essere sopravvissuto, Owen decide che è il momento di cambiare vita. Obiettivi principali: innamorarsi e rientrare in contatto col figlio

programme.title: CHEERLEADER PERICOLOSE
programme.desc: Maisy si trasferisce nel college dov'è morta sua sorella per scoprire la verità: scopre così che molte cheerleader hanno un secondo lavoro che potrebbe collegare molti indizi

programme.title: SCANDALO AL COLLEGE
programme.desc: Annie e Katie sono migliori amiche da sempre e il loro sogno è quello di frequentare il college di Pine State. Il loro sogno, però, deve scontrarsi con la realtà: non hanno i voti abbastanza alti per entrare in graduatoria. Qui parte il piano di riscatto, sono pronte a tutto pur di entrare perfino pagare altri per sostenere l'esame al posto loro. Quella che, però, sembra una semplice truffa d'identità, in realtà, si trasforma ben presto in un incubo con tanto di uccisioni e vite messe in pericolo.

programme.title: 13 PECCATI
programme.desc: Elliot è pieno di debiti. Una misteriosa telefonata lo informa che le telecamere nascoste di un game show lo stanno riprendendo e per vincere il premio in palio deve portare a termine tutti i 13 compiti che gli verranno assegnati.

programme.title: IN FULL BLOOM -I FIORI DELLA RABBIA
programme.desc: Fine seconda Guerra Mondiale. La yakuza organizza un incontro di pugilato invitando un pugile americano a combattere un atleta locale di fronte alle telecamere di tutto il mondo.

programme.title: Scambio di identità
programme.desc: Connie, nubile ed incinta, viaggia in direzione di Boston in treno ed incontra una giovane e facoltosa coppia di sposini in luna di miele, Hugh e Patricia. Durante il tragitto, il convoglio subisce un incidente grave e la ragazza finisce in ospedale.

programme.title: Finché giudice non ci separi
programme.desc: Massimo, Paolo, Roberto e Mauro sono quattro amici, tutti separati e accomunati dal rancore verso il giudice che ha seguito le loro separazioni. Situazioni paradossali e sorprese sempre dietro l'angolo, in una commedia divertentissima.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Thongs e Octopus accettano un lavoro dal loro padrone di casa, in cambio di una lauta ricompensa: rapire un bambino. Ben presto, il bebè risveglia forti sentimenti paterni nei due truffatori, portando a complicazioni quando si tratta di riconsegnarlo.

programme.title: Premonitions
programme.desc: L'agente speciale dell'FBI Joe Merriwether non riesce a fare luce su una misteriosa catena di delitti. Ingaggia così un suo ex collaboratore in pensione, il medico psicanalista John Clancy, allo scopo di risolvere il caso.

programme.title: Sharon Tate
programme.desc: Incinta del regista Roman Polanski e in attesa del suo ritorno dall'Europa, l'attrice Sharon Tate è perseguitata dalla visione di una sua imminente morte.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Fong è un ladro che ha il vizio del gioco. L'occasione per fare un po' di soldi si presenta quando un magnate gli offre l'incarico di rapire un bambino. L'uomo accetta, ma l'unico problema è che deve prendersi cura del piccolo per qualche giorno.

programme.title: Cloud Atlas
programme.desc: Sei storie attraverso i secoli. Una sola anima. Tom Hanks e Halle Berry spiccano in un cast stellare, in un intreccio di storie tra passato, presente e futuro. Quando i personaggi si incontrano tra una vita e l'altra, le loro azioni generano delle conseguenze.

programme.desc: Kim, da vero maschiaccio, è stata una campionessa di skateboard ma ha dovuto abbandonare i suoi sogni di gloria per trovare lavoro presso un fast food e mantenere se stessa e il padre.

programme.title: Amore a prima… offerta
programme.desc: Liz è soddisfatta della sua vita. L'unica cosa che le manca è il suo Principe Azzurro. È allora che George Barrow, un affascinante magnate immobiliare, bussa alla sua porta. È lui l'uomo perfetto che stava cercando, o la sta solo corteggiando per convincerla a vendere la casa di famiglia?

programme.title: Playboys – Donnaioli
programme.desc: Una giovane donna, Tara Maguire (Robin Wright), scandalizza il suo villaggio di provincia irlandese negli anni '50 avendo un bambino fuori dal matrimonio e rifiutandosi di nominare il padre. Ha una bellezza rara e ogni uomo in città la desidera, soprattutto il sergente Hegarty (Albert Finney).

programme.title: Ritorno a Romance
programme.desc: Zoe Davis è una wedding planner di successo e molto determinata che vive in una grande città. Quando il padre le chiede di aiutarlo nel ristorante di famiglia, lei torna volentieri nella sua accogliente città natale di Romance, nell'Oregon.

programme.title: Knight of cups
programme.desc: Il padre era solito leggere al figlio Rick (Christian Bale), ancora ragazzino, questa storia: “C'era una volta un giovane principe che il padre inviò in Egitto a cercare una perla. Ma, quando il principe arrivò, la gente gli porse una coppa.

programme.title: Black Water Abyss
programme.desc: Un gruppo di quattro amici stanno esplorando un sistema di caverne, ma rimangono bloccati all'interno delle grotte. Il problema non sarà soltanto l'allagamento e la mancanza di ossigeno, ma anche un branco di famelici alligatori pronti a dar loro la caccia

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Il ritorno
programme.desc: Teresa vive con Pietro e il piccolo Antonio, il figlio di due anni. Purtroppo la situazione economica, sociale e la poca affidabilità di Pietro costringono Teresa a compiere un gesto estremo per il quale finisce in carcere per dieci anni.

programme.title: Family therapy
programme.desc: Aleksander è ossessionato dall'immagine della sua famiglia perfetta, tanto da voler partecipare a un concorso per vincere un viaggio nello spazio. L'equilibrio precario esplode quando il figlio di una precedente relazione si unisce al nucleo familiare, scoperchiando bugie e segreti taciuti.

programme.title: Il ragazzo dei miei sogni
programme.desc: Troppo impegnata con il lavoro, Susan chiede alla sua assistente Abby di trovare l'uomo perfetto per lei. Abby si mette alla ricerca e seleziona Dan, ma finisce per innamorarsene proprio lei.

programme.title: Due cuori e una baita
programme.desc: La stacanovista Jillian vuole vendere una baita di montagna, ma il bel custode Liam le fa un'offerta. Volano scintille quando trasformano la baita in un resort. Ma quando gli affari non vanno secondo i piani, Jillian rinuncerà a tutto per amore?

programme.title: Tentazioni Irresistibili
programme.desc: Tre uomini devono affrontare la loro dipendenza dal sesso e continuare a vivere una vita normale in una New York dalle mille tentazioni. Con Mark Ruffalo e Gwyneth Paltrow.

programme.title: La signora Dalloway
programme.desc: Clarissa Dalloway, un'attempata signora di Londra, riflette riguardo la propria vita e sulle decisioni prese ingenuamente.

programme.title: If only she knew
programme.desc: Quando una giovane donna apre il negozio dei suoi sogni seguendo solo l'istinto, tutto sembra andare per il verso giusto: il successo arriva e incontra l'uomo ideale. Ma l'arrivo inatteso di un altro uomo mette tutto in discussione.

programme.title: Il fiume della vita
programme.sub-title: Kwai Il fiume della vita - Kwai
programme.desc: In Thailandia, Sarah ritrova il padre e, tra scontri e rivelazioni, nasce una nuova complicità.

programme.title: Amore in azione Amore in azione
programme.desc: Un esperto di fitness deve mettere in forma una star del cinema per il suo prossimo film d'azione.

programme.title: Immenhof
programme.sub-title: La grande promessa Immenhof - La grande promessa
programme.desc: Quando Cagliostro, il cavallo campione viene avvelenato, Lou e le sue sorelle fanno di tutto per salvarlo.

programme.title: Un amore sul ghiaccio Un amore sul ghiaccio
programme.desc: Una pattinatrice incontra un pescatore che le dimostra che c'è molto più della semplice competizione.

programme.title: Il fiume della vita
programme.sub-title: Kwai Il fiume della vita - Kwai
programme.desc: In Thailandia, Sarah ritrova il padre e, tra scontri e rivelazioni, nasce una nuova complicità.

programme.title: Dopo l'amore
programme.desc: Marie e Boris, dopo quindici anni di matrimonio, vivono separati in casa a causa di difficoltà economiche e per il bene delle figlie. Questo dramma contemporaneo esplora i paradossi e le sfide di una relazione che si sgretola lentamente.

programme.title: La storia dell'amore
programme.desc: C'era una volta un ragazzo, Léo, che amava una ragazza, Alma. Le aveva promesso che l'avrebbe fatta ridere per tutta la vita, ma la guerra li ha separati. Da un paesino della Polonia negli anni Trenta alla New York dei giorni nostri ripercorriamo la straordinaria storia d'amore tra Léo, l'uomo che è sopravvissuto a tutto e Alma, la donna più amata del mondo. Oggi un'altra Alma, adolescente newyorchese e contagiata dallo stesso virus meraviglioso dell'amore, vuole essere la donna più amata del mondo. Sembra che niente leghi Léo alla giovane Alma ma… L'amore attraverserà il tempo e i continenti per unire i loro destini.

programme.title: Non ti posso dimenticare
programme.desc: Fred Astaire impersona un eroico pilota della seconda guerra mondiale innamorato di una dattilografa la quale, ignara del suo valore, lo disprezza credendolo un imboscato. Alla fine la donna scoprirà la verità.

programme.title: The Gods
programme.desc: In un moderno Romeo e Giulietta, Mikey James, un imbroglione cresciuto per strada con i suoi due fratelli, va a lavorare per la famiglia Fasano mentre cerca disperatamente di trovare una via d'uscita dal suo stile di vita frenetico.

programme.title: Papi Chulo
programme.desc: A Los Angeles, un solitario e alienato meteorologo televisivo "assume" un migrante latinoamericano di mezza età per essere suo amico.

programme.title: Un neomelodico presidente
programme.desc: Il cantante neomelodico Leopoldo Giappone, in arte Mimmo Dany, si candida a presidente della regione Campania con una lista a sé, l'UVC. Il suo sogno tuttavia resta quello di partecipare al reality show L'isola dei famosi, e per questo ha a che fare con la malavita.

programme.title: La Sorgente dell'Amore
programme.desc: Leila, giovane sposa magrebina, propone alle donne del suo villaggio di fare lo sciopero dell'amore: niente più sesso finché gli uomini non porteranno l'acqua al villaggio. E alla fine le donne la spunteranno.

programme.title: La Città invisibile
programme.desc: La terra trema e il mondo non è più lo stesso. Tutto cambia. Cambiano i paesaggi, le persone, la vita. Dalle rovine de L'Aquila nasce nuova vita. Questo è ciò che accade a Luca e Lucilla. Entrambi vittime del tragico terremoto del 6 aprile 2009, i due studenti universitari scelgono di non abbandonare la città e nemmeno i loro sogni.

programme.title: Sballati Per Le Feste!
programme.desc: Ethan, Isaac e Chris sono amici fin dall'infanzia e per un decennio si sono incontrati una volta all'anno per una reunion la vigilia di Natale, una serata all'insegna della dissolutezza e dell'ilarità. Ora che stanno entrando nell'età adulta, la tradizione sta volgendo al termine e per renderla il più possibile memorabile, si prefiggono di trovare il 'Nutcracka Ball', il Santo Graal delle feste natalizie.

programme.title: Madeline
programme.desc: In una vecchia casa di Parigi coperta di vigne vivevano dodici bambine in fila per due. La più piccola, sotto il sole o sotto la pioggia, era l'intrepida Madeline (Hatty Jones), e lei è l'eroina di questa commedia per la famiglia basata sulla serie di libri per ragazzi di Ludwig Bemelmans su una studentessa parigina e le sue compagne di scuola.

programme.title: Non È Un'Altra Stupida Commedia Americana
programme.desc: Questo film è una parodia delle convenzioni e i cliché del suo genere. L'esclusa della scuola, Janey Briggs (Chyler Leigh), un'aspirante artista con occhiali, coda di cavallo e una perenne salopette macchiata di pittura, è l'oggetto di una scommessa tra il giocatore di football Jake Wyler (Chris Evans) e Austin (Eric Christian Olsen) che non può essere trasformata nella “reginetta del ballo”.

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Liberamente ispirato alla striscia di fumetti Little Orphan Annie, il film racconta la storia di un'orfanella che viene ospitata per una settimana nella villa di un ricco possidente che successivamente propone all'orfanotrofio che ospita la piccola di adottarla. La direttrice dell'istituto si opporrà però con tutte le sue forze all'adozione della piccola Annie.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Peter Banning è un avvocato quarantenne che non ricorda di essere stato Peter Pan. Peter e famiglia vanno a Londra a trovare nonna Wendy. I bambini dormono nella stessa camera dove la storia di Peter Pan ebbe inizio, ma vengono rapiti da Capitan Uncino. Allora Peter, aiutato da Wendy, tornerà il Pan del passato e, incoraggiato da Campanellino, torna all'Isola Che Non C'è per salvare i suoi bambini.

programme.title: Quando le donne si chiamavano Madonne
programme.desc: Tre giovani vanno a Prato, tra amori, un processo per adulterio e conquiste di belle ragazze del posto.

programme.title: Il paramedico
programme.desc: Mario vince un'auto, ma dopo un furto da parte dei terroristi finisce in carcere.

programme.title: I baroni
programme.desc: Leopoldo, impotente prima delle nozze, guarisce grazie a una danese, ma deve sposare Mariantonia per ereditare.

programme.title: Sesso e volentieri
programme.desc: Dieci piccoli episodi collegati dal filo rosso del ""sesso e volentieri""

programme.title: Totò cerca casa
programme.desc: Totò è un uomo alla ricerca disperata di una casa, ma si trova coinvolto in una serie di situazioni esilaranti e complicate. Tra inganni e malintesi, il film esplora con ironia le difficoltà della vita quotidiana.

programme.title: Anni difficili
programme.desc: Con Umberto Spadaro, Massimo Girotti e Ave Ninchi, Aldo Piscitello deve aderire al Partito Fascista e affrontare la guerra. Tra doveri familiari e scelte morali, cerca il coraggio di restare fedele a sé stesso in un'Italia in crisi.

programme.title: La donna scimmia
programme.desc: Commedia grottesca di Marco Ferreri con Ugo Tognazzi: Antonio scopre Maria, tutta pelosa, e la porta in tournée come fenomeno da baraccone. Tra scherzi, equivoci e situazioni assurde, il loro strano duo regala risate e sorprese.

programme.title: Il fischio al naso
programme.desc: Un uomo, interpretato da Ugo Tognazzi, si ritrova coinvolto in una serie di situazioni comiche e paradossali, tutto a causa di un fischio al naso che cambia inaspettatamente la sua vita. Una commedia surreale e ironica che esplora la follia delle circostanze.

programme.title: The Dentist
programme.desc: La vita del dr. Feinstone, un dentista di Beverly Hills, sembra apparentemente perfetta, ma in realtà nasconde un terribile segreto. Impazzito dopo il tradimento della moglie, infligge raccapriccianti torture ai suoi ignari pazienti.

programme.title: Project A
programme.desc: Hong Kong, 1800. Mentre gli inglesi sono occupati a governare le terre, i pirati sono i padroni dei mari facendo razzie delle imbarcazioni che incontrano. Nonostante vari tentativi la Guardia Costiera non riesce a sconfiggerli.

programme.title: Freak Show
programme.desc: La storia dell'adolescente Billy Bloom, che decide di candidarsi come reginetta del ballo nonostante la sua scuola ultra conservatrice.

programme.title: The Hoax
programme.desc: Lo scrittore Clifford Irving (Richard Gere) cerca una storia per dare una svolta alla sua carriera in picchiata.. Con l'aiuto dell'amico Dick Suskind (Alfred Molina), convince il suo editore di essere diventato amico intimo del leggendario miliardario eccentrico Howard Hughes.

programme.title: Una spia al liceo
programme.desc: Molly Morris viene ingaggiata dall'Fbi per un'operazione sotto copertura in una confraternita universitaria. Dovrà trasformarsi da dura e scaltra investigatrice privata in una raffinata e sofisticata studentessa universitaria, per proteggere la figlia di un ex-boss.

programme.title: Restiamo Amici
programme.desc: Alessandro viene improvvisamente contattato, dal Brasile, dal suo vecchio amico Gigi. In punto di morte, l'uomo ha un ultimo favore: per ereditare i tre milioni di euro che gli ha lasciato suo padre deve intestarli a suo figlio. Ma Gigi non ha eredi.

programme.title: 10 Cose Da Fare Prima Di Lasciarsi
programme.desc: Ben e Abigail si conoscono a un appuntamento al buio in un bar e, per gioco, stilano una lista delle dieci cose da fare insieme prima di lasciarsi. Dopo aver passato la notte insieme, le cose prendono una piega inaspettata.

programme.title: Alaska
programme.desc: Un californiano insoddisfatto accoglie con gioia la notizia di un'eredità che lo attende in Alaska. Ma per impadronirsene deve purtroppo affrontare una prova molto dura.

programme.title: Interstate 60
programme.desc: Dal creatore di Ritorno al Futuro. Neil è un pittore ostacolato dal padre che vorrebbe vederlo laureato in legge. La situazione cambia all'improvviso quando incontra One Wish Grant (premio Oscar Gary Oldman), uomo in grado di esaudire ogni desiderio.

programme.title: East Is East
programme.desc: Nel 1971 George Khan, pakistano tradizionalista, è emigrato nel Regno Unito dove possiede un negozio di fish & chips e ha sposato Ella. I loro sette figli sembrano poco inclini a seguire le direttive paterne per quanto riguarda la religione islamica.

programme.title: Il Gladiatore di Roma
programme.desc: Nell'arena e nei palazzi del potere, un gladiatore combatte tra intrighi e duelli per cambiare il proprio destino.

programme.title: Nel Segno di Roma
programme.desc: Con Anita Ekberg e diretto anche dal grande Michelangelo Antonioni.Nell'antica Roma, guerre, alleanze e passioni si intrecciano mentre un impero lotta per imporre il proprio destino.

programme.title: Giulio Cesare conquistatore delle Gallie
programme.desc: Giulio Cesare guida l'esercito romano nella battaglia contro i ribelli in Gallia.

programme.title: Samoa, regina della giungla
programme.desc: Diretto da Guido Malatesta, con Edwige Fenech.Tra giungle inesplorate e pericoli nascosti, una coraggiosa regina guida il suo popolo contro invasori e tradimenti, tra azione e avventura.

programme.title: I predoni della città
programme.desc: Uno sceriffo cerca di fermare i conflitti tra contadini nel West dopo la guerra civile.

programme.title: Requiem per un gringo
programme.desc: Un euro-western atipico e oscuro, con un enigmatico astrologo in abito leopardato al centro della scena. Tra vendetta e atmosfere insolite, il film si distingue per il suo tono cupo e per suggestioni che richiamano l'horror europeo, offrendo un western all'italiana decisamente fuori dagli schemi.

programme.title: La valle della vendetta
programme.desc: I figli di un barone del bestiame del Colorado, uno biologico e l'altro adottivo, si risentono e lottano per il controllo dell'impero del bestiame del padre.

programme.title: La tigre venuta dal fiume Kwai
programme.desc: In Thailandia, un giovane coraggioso promette di restituire alla famiglia del suo amico defunto tutti i suoi averi. Ma l'America è lontana e piena di pericoli: per mantenere la promessa dovrà affrontare viaggi estenuanti e sfide mortali.

programme.title: I tre spietati
programme.desc: Dopo l'omicidio del padre durante un furto di cavalli, i tre figli pianificano vendetta vent'anni dopo.

programme.title: 100.000 dollari per Lassiter
programme.desc: Martin è sfruttato dai banditi finché Lassiter non gli rivela il nascondiglio di colui che lo ha reso storpio.

programme.title: Il mercenario
programme.desc: Un mercenario polacco e un minatore guidano una rivoluzione contro il governo oppressivo del Messico.

programme.title: L'ombra di Zorro
programme.desc: I fratelli Billy e Dan vanno in California per uccidere Zorro e vendicare la morte del loro fratello.

programme.desc: Dallas e Kelly, in gara per un ranch, affrontano i fratelli Wright e altri rivali.

programme.title: Chocolate
programme.desc: Zen è una ragazzina autistica che cresce guardando film di Bruce Lee. Sviluppa riflessi incredibili e una predisposizione per il combattimento a mani nude, assorbendo con facilità estrema ogni tecnica. Sua madre ha bisogno della chemioterapia.

programme.title: The Goblin
programme.desc: Dopo dieci anni di carcere per un delitto non suo, il killer Goblin scopre che l'amico per cui si è sacrificato ha usato la sua identità e rapito sua figlia per ricattarlo.

programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: The thieves
programme.desc: Una infame banda di cinque ladri coreani, guidati da Popie, riceve un'offerta irresistibile da Macao Park, un ex partner: rubare la "lacrima del sole", un diamante di 318 carati dal valore di 20 milioni di dollari, nascosto in un casinò di Macao.

programme.title: Legend Of Tsunami Warrior
programme.desc: Un principe ribelle, alleato con i pirati del Corvo Nero, mette sotto scacco il regno della Regina Hijau. Il giovane Pari, in grado di controllare l'oceano e le creature che lo popolano lotterà per liberare il regno della Regina Hijau e sconfiggere i pirati.

programme.title: Scrivimi ancora
programme.desc: Rosie e Alex, amici da sempre, lottano contro distanza e amori sbagliati per un legame speciale.

programme.title: The Best of Me
programme.desc: Una coppia di vecchi compagni di liceo si ricongiunge dopo molti anni quando i due tornano nel proprio paese natale.

programme.title: Il ritratto di una donna contro
programme.desc: Jane Austen, sognatrice ribelle, sfida le convenzioni per amore nell'Inghilterra del 1795.

programme.title: Scrivimi ancora
programme.desc: Rosie e Alex, amici da sempre, lottano contro distanza e amori sbagliati per un legame speciale.

programme.title: The Circle
programme.desc: Quando Mae viene assunta per lavorare a The Circle, la prima azienda di tecnologia e social media del mondo, è sicura che le sia capitata l'opportunità più grande della sua vita.

programme.title: Apocalisse Di Ghiaccio
programme.desc: Il pianeta è stato contagiato da un potentissimo virus che non lascia sopravvissuti. Già in preda a una crisi globale, l'umanità dovrà lottare contro un massiccio vortice polare che minaccia di ricoprire il pianeta di ghiaccio.

programme.title: 2:22 Il destino e' gia' scritto
programme.desc: Dylan Boyd si rende conto che le sue giornate sono scandite dal replicarsi di piccoli eventi apparentemente casuali che si ripetono identici ogni giorno alla stessa ora, in una successione che termina puntualmente alle 2.22 alla stazione del treno.

programme.title: Light of my life
programme.desc: E' la storia di un padre e di sua figlia Rag di dieci anni, che sono costretti ad una vita nomade dopo essere sopravvissuti a un'epidemia che ha decimato la popolazione mondiale sterminando, quasi totalmente, quella femminile.

programme.title: Viaggio nel buio
programme.desc: 1992, Usa. Il giovane canadese Bruce Curtis va a New York per incontrare il suo amico Scott Franz. Ma durante il viaggio accade l'inimmaginabile e la vita dei due giovani cambierà per sempre quando diventeranno protagonisti di uno dei più efferati omicidi domestici degli anni 90. Uno spaccato crudo e violento di una generazione raccontato dalle pagine di cronaca che hanno sconvolto l'America.

programme.title: Blood of the Virgins
programme.desc: Sometime in 19th century Argentina, the mysterious Gustavo spoils Ofelia's wedding night by turning her into his vampire bride. Fast forward to the Swinging Sixties, where a group of hip teenagers foolishly spend the night at an old lodge that is reputed to be haunted.

programme.title: Acampamento Crepusculo
programme.desc: Depois de descobrir que correm o risco de nao conseguir se formar, 6 alunos concordam em fazer um acampamento no fim de semana para obter credito extra. Quando eles descobrem o passado sombrio do acampamento, eles logo aprendem que devem ficar juntos para sobreviver.

programme.title: Immagini Sporche
programme.desc: Alexander 'Sasha' Shulgin è lo scienziato dietro più di 200 composti psichedelici tra cui l'MDMA, più comunemente noto come Ecstasy. Considerato uno dei più grandi chimici del ventesimo secolo, la vasta gamma di scoperte di Sasha ha avuto un profondo impatto nel campo della ricerca psichedelica.

programme.title: Trappola Cinese
programme.desc: Paul Konan è un fotografo tedesco che, in Cina per realizzare un servizio sulla popolazione locale, si innamora dell'affascinante guida Liyun. La donna poco dopo viene rapita dalla Triade, la mafia locale, e l'uomo, tornato in Germania, inizia a subire pesanti ricatti dall'organizzazione criminale ed è costretto a sottostarvi per salvare Liyun.

programme.title: Lupo di generazione
programme.desc: Lupo di generazione parla di un giovane imprenditore che sta per perdere la sua attività e sceglie di coltivare marijuana come un modo semplice per salvarla.

programme.title: Il Gioco Dell'inganno
programme.desc: Sophie, stilista in procinto di lanciare la sua prima linea di abbigliamento, trova uno dei suoi dipendenti assassinato. Una serie di spaventosi eventi la porta a realizzare che deve agire in fretta per salvare la sua vita.
